message.content: {"choice":"EDIT THIS ONE","reason":"The owner explicitly asked for reusable cmux core animations and praised cmux before, so this is unlikely to be killed. But the poster shows the browser pane covering and clipping the terminal, and the frame is a mostly white panel that doesn't clearly show 'every agent'. That matches the kind of execution fixes this owner flagged before (the screen-recording skew, the boring white panels), so a revision is more likely than a straight approval."}
message.reasoning:
The owner wants cmux included among the core animations, but the poster shows the browser pane sitting over the terminal and clipping its left side, so I'm considering an EDIT as with the earlier "Laptop, fleet and panel" one. The high ratings for core animations came from 3D Higgsfield work, while this is a flat screen recording, so I'm weighing whether it fits that group at all.

The poster's white panels and the mismatch with "every agent" make me wonder whether it needs new content rather than just an edit. The clipped terminal behind the browser pane still points toward an EDIT, though, so I'm leaning that way.
